heroes.prompt:

Asset type: transparent game sprite sheet for Rift Arena mobile MOBA
Primary request: Create ONE PNG image exactly 1536x1024 pixels, transparent background, containing exactly six original full-body fantasy MOBA combat sprites in an exact 3-column by 2-row grid. The six cells are each exactly 512x512 pixels: x=0–511, 512–1023, 1024–1535; y=0–511 and 512–1023. No gutters, no grid lines.
Subject order: TOP LEFT silver armored knight with a cyan glowing sword (sentinel); TOP MIDDLE violet hooded star mage with floating crystals (arcanist); TOP RIGHT female teal elf archer holding a bow (ranger); BOTTOM LEFT golden stone tank warrior (bulwark); BOTTOM MIDDLE masked dark assassin with magenta blades (shade); BOTTOM RIGHT white and gold healer carrying an emerald staff (oracle).

Each entire silhouette including weapons and glow fits within 85 percent of cell width and height, with transparent padding all around. All six isolated and wholly contained in their own square.

Constraints: original characters, exact prescribed ordering, exactly six sprites, no overlaps, no cropping, no ground planes, no ground circles, no text, no labels, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Keep the invisible cell boundaries perfectly aligned.
